context_rules: The same protected fact has the same disclosure ceiling across all channels.
Role changes, revocation and reconnect require re-evaluation before rendering cached copy or actions.
A deep link cannot turn safe-unavailable into an existence disclosure.
Service-actor diagnostics never become a user permission bypass.
Optional AI receives only the already-redacted authorized projection and has no decision authority.
Observer and Player surfaces never expose GM truth through error wording, counts, timing or recovery choices.
